examples.text: **A specific example would be if the team needs another day to decide.**

examples.text: **A specific example would be if the revised plan has not been shared yet.**

examples.text: **A specific example would be if the client asked for more detail.**

examples.text: **A specific example would be if the data need another check.** The team will discuss it before deciding how to proceed.
